name: Keep game rules callable without a browser
instruction: A game's scoring, hit detection, movement, and state transitions are implemented in exported functions that can run without canvas, DOM, or animation-frame APIs.
relevant_when: A src/games/<game-id>/game.ts file defines gameplay state or scoring logic and a CarnivalGame start method.
context: AGENTS.md house rule 4 and the Water Cannon example keep game rules separate from browser input and rendering so Vitest can exercise them.
scope_reason: The file contains the game-rule functions and the start method that invokes them; a provided CanvasRenderingContext2D used only for drawing is not game-rule state.

checklist.name: exported-browser-free-rules
checklist.rule: Gameplay state changes and score calculations are exported and do not access window, document, canvas, localStorage, or requestAnimationFrame.

checklist.name: start-delegates-rules
checklist.rule: The start method handles browser input and animation but delegates gameplay state changes and scoring to those browser-free functions.
